description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed verbatim by Make Distiller Fast: "a, b, c approved."). Page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.byte-walk-loop.html (v7, walkthrough section).

(a) The rule: a place in the code is a function only if something outside its function can arrive there (a call from elsewhere, a call's return, the runtime); everything reached only by its own function's direct transfers is a block. Clause bodies become blocks of their function; a self tail call is a branch to the head block; a branch join with two direct predecessors is a block (absorbs fz-9x7.35, which becomes this ticket's acceptance probe: `(if n > 5, do: n * 3, else: n) + 1` builds no continuation on run/build). A try body that the try only tail-calls falls under the same rule.

Scope: EntryFns' "exactly one direct transfer" becomes "every arriving transfer is a direct transfer from its own function"; lower_clause_body_fn and every __clause_N symbol go; a self tail call is a jump charging one reduction.

(b) One reduction per step: the dispatch -> clause-body transfer no longer exists and charges nothing. Four pins move; one fixture's copied-bytes pin rises 1.6% (authorized by the ruling; cause not isolated for that fixture).

Measured on the spike (bench, develop 394fa1313): walk 96.6 -> 61.4 instr/byte, 20.8 -> ~8 cycles/byte; distiller -7.85% instructions, -14.87% cycles, peak RSS 1407 -> 1157 MB (peak in-use 889 -> 795 MB: the dispatch->clause transfer stops being a yield point), binary 3,748,120 -> 3,495,608 bytes. Spike: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-distill-hunt/spike.394fa1313.patch (FZ_SPIKE_CLAUSE_BLOCKS and FZ_SPIKE_SELF_JUMP hunks only; throwaway). A temporary assertion that an executable's entries never form a cycle held across 6,976 tests.

Acceptance: interp, JIT, AOT agree; the .35 probe builds no continuation; pins move only as (b) authorizes, falls lowered; full gate.
title: A place in the code is a function only if something outside its function arrives there
